messages:
Sam - AE: FYI Rancher POC hitting failures on our /rerank endpoint when they switch to the 'encoder-v2' model. started after they rotated keys yesterday.
Maya (Eng): Thanks Sam. Can you paste the client error and any server logs?
Sam - AE: Client sees: 'error: embedding dim mismatch: expected 1536 got 768'
Sam - AE: They claim they didn't change their encoder config. Quick repro: POST /v1/rerank body with vectors shape (N,768) -> 400
Alex R: @Maya logs from our side show a deserialization warning then a validation error: 
```
2026-03-19T14:02:12Z WARN model-loader: quantized model metadata missing `embedding_dim`
2026-03-19T14:02:12Z ERROR rerank-worker: input_vector_dim(768) != model_expected_dim(1536)
```
Maya (Eng): OK two possibilities: either the customer switched to a half-precision variant that expects 1536, OR their client is still using the legacy encoder. Sam, do you have the client SDK version?
Sam - AE: They sent yarn.lock showing `@redwood/vector-sdk@1.4.0` (we recommend 1.6+).
Jordan (CS): Also heads-up from procurement: they're asking for a pricing delta if we enable a temporary dedicated pool for the POC. Can we estimate cost impact of spinning up a small dedicated instance for a week? :moneybag:
Maya (Eng): For diagnostics first: ask them to run the simple checksum of model metadata and echo the model id the client thinks it's calling: `console.log(await client.model('encoder').info())`
Alex R: I pushed a small log change to surface model ids in rerank traces. DeployBot: deploy/rollout v2026.03.19.14 -> success :rocket:
Sam - AE: Customer ran the info check and returned: `model: encoder-v1, dims: 768`. But their rerank call was routed to `encoder-v2-quant` (1536). Somehow routing policy picked the quantized fallback.
Maya (Eng): That explains it. Routing policy will fallback to compatible shards by family but we mis-tagged encoder-v2-quant's metadata. I'll patch policy to enforce dim check before routing. Temporary workaround: in the rerank API validate and convert or reject with clearer error.
Sam - AE: Customer is blocked on POC validation tests atm. They also hit 429 rate limits when they retried many times after the error. Any chance we can grant a short higher quota?
Jordan (CS): I can approve a one-week quota bump for the trial account — will need the account id. Sam, send account + expected qps.
Alex R: Patch ready: PR #4823 adds stricter routing guard + clearer 400 with suggested remedy. Rolling to canary now.
Maya (Eng): Canary logs show rerank requests correctly rejected with: '400 embedding dim mismatch: expected 1536, got 768. Either use encoder-v2 client or call /embeddings with encoder-v1.' Sending sample curl for customer:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "encoder-v1", "candidates": [...], "query_vector": [/* 768 dims */]}'
```
Sam - AE: Sharing that with customer now. Also looping in Jordan on quota request.
Jordan (CS): Got account id. Approved + applied temporary quota bump. Send them guidance on avoiding retries after 4xx and on SDK upgrade.
Sam - AE: Customer upgraded SDK to 1.6.2 and now rerank flows succeed. They still asked if we can add a validation step client-side to warn before upload. Good product feedback. :thumbsup:
Maya (Eng): Filed GH issue for client-side dim validation and added a short note in the POC runbook about avoiding automatic retries on 4xx.
Alex R: Closing loop — PR merged, quota bumped, customer green. Marking thread resolved.
Sam - AE: Thanks team! I'll capture notes in the deal tracker and add the temporary dedicated cost estimate for Jordan.
Jordan (CS): Nice, will follow up on the pricing ask and security questionnaire next week.
